CREATE TABLE "public"."challenge_applications" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamp(3),
  "category" "Category" NOT NULL,
  "content" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamp(3),
  "decidedById" int4,
  "desiredDeadline" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "documentType" "DocumentType" NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "maxParticipants" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "sourceUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "ApplicationStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"ApplicationStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."challenge_participants" (
  "abandonedAt" timestamp(3),
  "challengeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."challenges" (
  "category" "Category" NOT NULL,
  "content" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" int4 NOT NULL,
  "deadline" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "deleteReason" text,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "deletedById" int4,
  "documentType" "DocumentType" NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "maxParticipants" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sourceApplicationId" int4,
  "sourceUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "ChallengeStatus" DEFAULT 'IN_PROGRESS'::"ChallengeStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."drafts" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "participantId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."feedbacks" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "workId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "actorId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dedupeKey" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "readAt" timestamp(3),
  "reason" text,
  "relatedChallengeId" int4,
  "relatedWorkId" int4,
  "type" "NotificationType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oauth_accounts" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "provider" "OAuthProvider" NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "grade" "UserGrade" DEFAULT 'NORMAL'::"UserGrade" NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nickname" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'USER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."work_likes" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "workId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."works" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "participantId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
